item.title: Kartal reaches Wuhan final as dream week continues
item.description: Britain's Sonay Kartal beats former French Open winner Jelena Ostapenko to reach the Wuhan Open final in only her third event after a six-month injury lay-off.

item.title: Fatigued Zverev 'overachieved' by reaching Shanghai semis
item.description: Alexander Zverev says he "overachieved" at the Shanghai Masters in reaching the semi-finals amid fatigue caused by his busy schedule.

item.title: Serb player banned until 2050 for tennis match-fixing
item.description: Stefan Milicevic is given a 24-year suspension from tennis - one of the most severe punishments outside of a lifetime ban - for match-fixing.

item.title: Kartal enjoys 'best week of career' after diving into deep end
item.description: Sonay Kartal's winning streak following a long injury lay-off continues as she seals a hard-fought victory over fifth seed Elina Svitolina in the quarter-finals of the Wuhan Open.

item.title: Star-studded Saudi exhibition postponed after deadly attacks
item.description: The Six Kings Slam exhibition event - featuring Carlos Alcaraz and Novak Djokovic - is postponed following a series of deadly attacks on Saudi Arabia.

item.title: Kartal wins again as impressive comeback continues
item.description: Britain's Sonay Kartal beats former Wimbledon finalist Jasmine Paolini in straight sets to reach the Wuhan Open quarter-finals.

item.title: Boulter beaten by Shnaider in Wuhan
item.description: British number one Katie Boulter loses to Diana Shnaider in the Wuhan Open first round.

item.title: Zverev secures year-end number one ranking
item.description: Alexander Zverev is guaranteed to finish his 2026 season as the world number one after Carlos Alcaraz suffers a surprise defeat in Shanghai.

item.title: Karaoke-singing Zheng makes history with China Open win
item.description: Zheng Qinwen becomes the first Chinese champion of the China Open after overcoming Mirra Andreeva in straight sets.

item.title: Djokovic suffers surprise Hurkacz loss in Shanghai
item.description: Novak Djokovic suffers a surprise second-round loss to Hubert Hurkacz at the Shanghai Masters, just three days after his triumph at the China Open in Beijing.

item.title: Wimbledon boss jokes military would love to 'sort out' influencers
item.description: Royal Marine Commandos providing security at Wimbledon would like "nothing more than to sort out" disruptive social media influencers at the prestigious tournament, its chief executive jokes.

item.title: Ticket rises and more TV packages - why is price of sport increasing?
item.description: The price of sports tickets and TV subscriptions are on the rise - so what is behind the increases and how are they justified?

item.title: Calm in real life but demons on court - Medvedev finally runs out of chances
item.description: Daniil Medvedev once said you would need to knock on his hotel door at 6am for seven days in a row to make him angry - but his China Open disqualification was no surprise.

item.title: 'Draining' few days for Gauff after online racist abuse
item.description: Coco Gauff says she had a "draining" few days after receiving racist abuse online before her fourth-round China Open exit.

item.title: Sinner out for rest of season with knee injury
item.description: World number one Jannik Sinner will not play again in 2026 because of an ongoing right knee injury.

item.title: 'Means more than just a trophy' - Djokovic claims 102nd title of career
item.description: Novak Djokovic claims the 102nd title of his astonishing career as Alex de Minaur retires injured from the China Open final.

item.title: Medvedev disqualified from Djokovic match for hitting spectator with ball
item.description: Daniil Medvedev is disqualified from the China Open after hitting a spectator in the face with a ball during his semi-final against Novak Djokovic.

item.title: More top-level events to award equal prize money in 'major milestone'
item.description: The Women's Tennis Association confirms all its combined 1000 events will award equal prize money from 2027 in a "major milestone".

item.title: History made as Zheng becomes first Chinese woman to win China Open
item.description: Zheng Qinwen makes history in Beijing as she beats Mirra Andreeva in straight sets to win the China Open, becoming the first Chinese woman to win the tournament.

item.title: Djokovic ends trophy drought with victory in China
item.description: Novak Djokovic wins the China Open for a seventh time after Alex de Minaur retires in the final in Beijing, as the Serb wins the 102nd title of his career.

item.title: Sabalenka crashes out of China Open after defeat by Bartunkova
item.description: World number two Aryna Sabalenka crashes out of the China Open after a surprise straight-set defeat by 34th-ranked Nikola Bartunkova.

item.title: Bouzkova beats Kartal as Czech Republic take BJK Cup lead over GB
item.description: Sonay Kartal is narrowly beaten by Marie Bouzkova in the first singles match as Czech Republic take a 1-0 lead over Great Britain in the Billie Jean King Cup.

item.title: GB qualify for Davis Cup Finals after doubles win
item.description: Great Britain qualify for the Davis Cup Finals after taking an unassailable 3-0 lead over Ecuador as Henry Patten and Neal Skupski beat Gonzalo Escobar and Diego Hidalgo 6-3 6-4.

item.title: Sabalenka stunned by Bartunkova at China Open
item.description: World number two Aryna Sabalenka follows Elena Rybakina out the door at the China Open as she falls to a surprise defeat by Nikola Bartunkova.

item.title: Gauff condemns racist abuse after China Open win
item.description: Coco Gauff says she suffered racial abuse on social media after an incident during her win over Sun Xinran at the China Open.

item.title: 'I kept fighting right to the end' - emotional Nishikori retires
item.description: A tearful Kei Nishikori says he "kept fighting right to the end" as the former world number four ends his professional career at the Japan Open.

item.title: Navarro opens up on health struggles that caused 'deep anger' on court
item.description: American Emma Navarro says she has gained her "life back" as she shares her long-running health problems that caused significant weight loss, fatigue, dizziness and left her "feeling deep internal anger" on the court.

item.title: Alcaraz wins after saving match points as Europe lead Laver Cup
item.description: Carlos Alcaraz narrowly avoids back-to-back singles defeats for the first time in 18 months as Team Europe lead Team World at the Laver Cup.

item.title: Czechs beat Ukraine for 12th Billie Jean King Cup title
item.description: The Czech Republic ease past Ukraine to win the Billie Jean King Cup for the 12th time thanks to wins for 2026 Wimbledon finalists Karolina Muchova and Linda Noskova.

item.title: 'Be comfortable in your own identity' - Agassi's advice to Raducanu
item.description: As Emma Raducanu plots a route back to the pinnacle of tennis, the Briton is taking inspiration from Andre Agassi's 2009 autobiography.

item.title: 'That is a stunner' - the best shots from GB v Ecuador in Fery's Davis Cup win
item.description: Watch the best shots from Arthur Fery's victory over Alvaro Guillen Meza as he helps Great Britain take a 2-0 lead over Ecuador in their Davis Cup qualifying match.

item.title: Zverev wins US Open to earn second Grand Slam victory
item.description: Alexander Zverev wins the second Grand Slam of his career by beating Ben Shelton 6-3, 6-6 (7-6), 5-7, 6-2 in the final of the US Open.

item.title: 'It feels amazing' - Zverev reflects on US Open win
item.description: Alexander Zverev says it was an "amazing feeling" to lift the US Open trophy after defeating Ben Shelton in the final.

item.title: Rybakina beats Sabalenka to win US Open for the first time
item.description: Elena Rybakina beats the two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka to win her first US Open and her third Grand Slam title overall.

item.title: Shelton reaches semis after beating Alcaraz in five-set epic
item.description: Watch highlights from Ben Shelton's thrilling five-set win over Carlos Alcaraz at the US Open which finished at 03:34 local time.

item.title: Williams sisters crash out of US Open after losing to Chan and Joint
item.description: Venus and Serena Williams fell short against 14th seeds Chan Hao-Ching and Maya Joint who beat them 6-3 6-7 (6-8) 7-6 (10-7) in front of a roaring Arthur Ashe stadium at the US Open.

item.title: Watch: Djokovic overcome with emotion during US Open loss
item.description: Novak Djokovic breaks down in tears during his first-round loss in the US Open against Argentina's Mariano Navone.

item.title: Williams and Alcaraz team up at US Open
item.description: Serena Williams and Carlos Alcaraz take on Flavio Coboilli and Belinda Bencic in the mixed doubles at the US Open, eventually losing 5-4 (7-4) 4-1.

item.title: 'Out of this world!' - Best shots of Wimbledon 2026
item.description: Enjoy the best shots of Wimbledon 2026, featuring Great Britain's Arthur Fery, Novak Djokovic, Coco Gauff and more.

item.title: Sinner beats Zverev in thriller to retain Wimbledon title
item.description: Jannik Sinner comes from a set down to defeat Alexander Zverev 6-7 (7-9) 7-6 (7-2) 6-3 6-4 to retain his Wimbledon title.

item.title: How Sinner slid his way to Wimbledon glory
item.description: BBC Sport's Jamie Murray, Tim Henman and Todd Woodbridge analyse Jannik Sinner's Wimbledon final victory against Alexander Zverev.

item.title: Sinner's best shots as world number one retains Wimbledon title
item.description: Enjoy the best of Jannik Sinner's title-retaining performance, as the world number one defeats Alexander Zverev in four sets in the men's singles final at Wimbledon 2026.

item.title: From struggling to walk to lifting trophy - how Rybakina triumphed
item.description: Elena Rybakina arrived in New York unable to walk without pain after injuring her foot. She leaves the city as the US Open champion and new world number one.

item.title: No Brits left in US Open singles - but are there reasons to be positive?
item.description: There will be no British interest in the second week of another Grand Slam at the US Open - but is it all doom and gloom?

item.title: Williams sisters exit US Open but excite - what does future hold?
item.description: Serena and Venus Williams may have lost in their US Open doubles return, but the veteran pair proved they can still compete on an entertaining night in New York.

item.title: 100 influencers invited to US Open spark debate on 'tennis etiquette'
item.description: The behaviour of influencers and content creators has become a major talking point at this year's US Open amid incidents of matches being disrupted.

item.title: Midnight matches and money disputes - why is tennis schedule such a headache?
item.description: BBC Sport explores the ongoing dispute over scheduling issues and late-night finishes at tennis' Grand Slam events.

item.title: 'I feel I am imprisoning myself' - Djokovic on doubts, childhood and future
item.description: Novak Djokovic discusses being his own biggest doubter and the Belgrade childhood that shaped him in a new documentary.

item.title: Dog walk and expletive text - key findings in Vondrousova anti-doping case
item.description: The full report into 2023 Wimbledon champion Marketa Vondrousova's four-year ban for refusing a doping test has been released - BBC Sport analyses the key findings.

item.title: What are the heat rules at Wimbledon?
item.description: BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team explains the heat rules at Wimbledon and when it is and is not safe to play in the heat

item.title: Who are the Wimbledon record-holders?
item.description: Our Ask Me Anything team looks at who has won the most Wimbledon singles and doubles titles.

item.title: What do hand signals mean in Wimbledon doubles?
item.description: Our Ask Me Anything team explains what the player hand signals mean in doubles matches.

item.title: What is Wimbledon's Last 8 Club?
item.description: BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team looks at what Wimbledon's Last 8 Club is and how players qualify for it.

item.title: How is the Wimbledon schedule decided? Your questions answered
item.description: Our Ask Me Anything team answer your questions about the Wimbledon schedule.
